              About this map

              Posted signs always win. This is the city's published schedule, and it can lag behind a sign change or miss a temporary closure.

              Schedule

              Street Sweeping Schedule from San Francisco Public Works, published on DataSF. This copy was downloaded : schedule rows covering curb sides. All times are San Francisco time.

              Holidays

              Following SFMTA's enforcement calendar: nothing is ticketed on New Year's Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas. On the other city holidays, meters and overnight sweeping (before 6 AM) are still enforced; time limits, permit areas and daytime sweeping are not. All four maps follow this, skipped sweeps are crossed out in each curb's list, and the ticket-risk math leaves out days that were not enforced. Dates after 2026 follow the same pattern and are not yet confirmed by SFMTA.

                Parking rules

                Meters, time limits, permit areas and tow-away hours come from SFMTA's Digital Curb, its record of every rule on every stretch of curb (pulled ). Where it has no record, DataSF's parking meters, meter schedules and parking regulations fill in. Each curb is colored by the rule that covers most of its length at the time you pick. Residents with the listed permit are exempt from time limits. Driveways, red curbs and bus stops within a block are not drawn separately.

                Ticket risk

                White zones

                Passenger loading zones (white curbs) from SFMTA's Digital Curb, of them. During their posted hours they are for picking up and dropping off only, with a 5-minute limit. Outside those hours most become ordinary parking, which the White zones map shows in green.

                Gaps

                Streets with parking rules but no sweeping schedule in Public Works' data, mostly on Russian Hill, Nob Hill, North Beach and in the Tenderloin, show in gray on the cleaning map and in full on the other maps. Streets missing entirely, such as park roads and the Presidio, are not in the data. Bike-lane sweeping is not included.
